full_judgment:
5. The instant suit has been filed on payment of advelorem Court Fees, with prayer to pass a decree in favour of the plaintiff against the defendant, his claim based on the claim arising out of negotiable instrument. 

 "Summary Suit-Leave from Court to defend-The scheme of Order XXXVII is summary one and a departure from the procedure provided for ordinal) suit. In the instant case there being no application filed within time mentioned in the summons, the question of granting leave does not arise. On the failure of the defendant to obtain the Court's leave to defend, the plaintiff is entitled to a decree."
